about: From the moment Edward Carnby and Aline Cedrac set foot on Shadow Island, they are stalked by mysterious, evil creatures intent on thwarting their quest to find the three ancient tablets that could hold the key to an otherworldly power. Danger lurks at every corner – do you have what it takes to fight back evil once and for all?
